style: 3D cartoon, Pixar, deadpan satire, hard moonlight
subject: aardwolf, striped hyena build, raised mane, tan fur; same animal
second_characters: termites in neckties like clerks, at the lens

props.can: an empty tin can in one paw, bottom to the lens

environment: moonlit savanna, red clay mounds, a dirt track, a full moon low
lighting: hard moonlight, twin headlight beams raking in from the lens, warm bounce off clay
motion_rule: The world flies at the hero: mounds and termites rush INTO the lens while he drives at the headlight beams across frame. A termite crosses the lens every beat. The camera never stops, new shot size every beat, one hero action per beat, he throws his body across the full frame width every beat, filling half the frame height, muzzle to the lens.

audio.rate: 3.8 syllables per second; each line fits its beat
audio.pacing: first word at 0.0; speech ends by 7.30; then wind
audio.lip_sync: muzzle to the lens, jaw opens every syllable, mouth empty while speaking; termites enter only when snapped
audio.pronunciation: ter-MI-tov, NOCH-yu, pro-kor-MIT, ot-DAT, E-ta, mo-YO

timeline.a: already huge in frame, headlight beams flaring at the lens, he tears across the frame into the light, belly flat; two termites tumble off a mound
on the move thrusts the can at the lens bottom first, shakes it - nothing falls; one termite dangles from the rim
wheels around mid-stride, mane whipping, beams sweeping over him; a column of termites marches across
strides across frame snapping termites off the clay wall, jaw clacking each syllable; termites swarm the can at the lens
bangs the can on a mound on the move, bottom to the lens, belly rounder; one termite spills out and crawls off
drives straight at the beams, sweeping the can along the lens; three termites chase it, neckties flying
skids sideways past the lens, flips the can over, belly swinging him; two termites rear up at the lens
plows across frame, belly dragging dust, the moon low beside him; a layer of termites parts ahead
mashes the can into clay with one paw on the move, eyes to the lens; one termite climbs it and spreads its legs
brakes sideways, drops the can - it lands upright and empty in the beam, belly sagging; termites stream around it
belly bloats from inside and yanks him sideways, paws scraping dust; A SWARM presses out from under it
slides sideways on his belly, legs splayed, paws dragging, dust plume in the beams, muzzle to the lens, blank stare past it; termites pour from under him
slides out past the right edge, limp paw last; the can stands alone upright in the beam, one termite crawls down it

must_appear: headlight beams from 0.00 and he drives at them; the full moon visible; upended empty can at 0.70, 2.10, 3.95; belly flat at 0.00, round at 3.95, sagging at 7.30; at 8.50 legs splayed, paws limp; at 9.25 the can alone upright in the beam, one termite crawls down it
negative_prompt: silent opening, still last second, hero riding anything, cart, rail, view from behind, lowered head during speech, parked camera, push in, motionless background, underexposed, murky, crushed blacks, unlit background, tongue out while speaking, snarl at camera, hero lifted off ground, subtitles, watermark, printed words, digits, Cyrillic or Latin, speech bubble, horizontal frame, black bars, speech after 7.30, English speech, foreign accent, extra limbs, a second hyena, wide shot, duplicate props
